changes.summary: Detects the @1mcp supervisor auto-respawn identity race in --status/--stop output (identityRace flag), waits for the supervisor to settle, and retries stop/start once so a transient race no longer blocks the disable/apply flow.
Adds six regression tests covering identity-race detection, settle-to-stopped, settle-then-retry, double-race error, and race-after-start recovery.

Patched CallTool Unknown-tool branch: when a tool name's server prefix maps to a server-level disabled:true entry, return an explicit isError result whose message contains 'Server is disabled: ...' instead of a bare 'Unknown tool'. Unknown tools with no matching prefix keep the original JSON-RPC error.
Records the toolRequestHandlers change plus the pre-existing windowsHide hunks; validated with git apply --check against pristine @1mcp/agent 0.38.2.
